column1: # The engine walks the party into Minoc and finds a sealed four-cell pocket:

# and the town's eleven NPCs are all unreachable on foot. Either Minoc's
# entrance really is enclosed or the engine's passability for this town is
# wrong. Same keystrokes both sides; the echoes say which.
